title.value: Measuring Progress in Fine-grained Vision-and-Language Understanding
title.justification: The paper provides an in-depth analysis of fine-grained vision-and-language models, emphasizing their understanding and evaluation capabilities.
title.quote: Measuring Progress in Fine-grained Vision-and-Language Understanding

extractions.description: This paper investigates the limitations of current vision-and-language models in understanding fine-grained aspects of vision-and-language tasks. It evaluates recent models for their ability to perform fine-grained understanding, such as interpreting relationships, verbs, and numbers within images. The study also explores the impact of modeling innovations and data quality on these models, encouraging a combined approach for improving fine-grained understanding.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on evaluating and understanding the capabilities of vision-and-language models for fine-grained tasks but does not directly address eco-responsible AI applications or any environmental impact.
primary_category.quote: While pretraining on large-scale image–text data from the Web has facilitated rapid progress on many vision-and-language (V&L) tasks, recent work has demonstrated that pretrained models lack 'fine-grained' understanding.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not address or relate to any of the predefined eco-responsible categories as its core focus is on enhancing the understanding of vision-and-language interactions.
secondary_categories.quote: Consequently, it is unclear if the performance gains are due to tighter, more fine-grained representations introduced by model innovations at the pretraining stage.

primary_sub_category.justification: As the paper does not discuss any specific eco-responsible sub-category, this is not applicable.
primary_sub_category.quote: Consequently, it is unclear if the performance gains are due to tighter, more fine-grained representations introduced by model innovations at the pretraining stage.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: There are no sub-categories in the eco-responsible AI space that fit the focus of this paper.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: To better understand and quantify progress in this direction, we investigate four competitive V&L models on four fine-grained benchmarks.

new_primary_category.justification: No new eco-responsible category was identified in this paper as the focus is purely on the technical advancement and benchmarking of vision-and-language models.
new_primary_category.quote: Our results suggest that to make progress in fine-grained understanding, modeling innovations (e.g., through object-centric losses) as well as data quality and richness are more effective than scaling up Web data alone.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category specific to eco-responsibility was suggested in this paper due to its abstract focus on technical model evaluation.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The study also explores the impact of modeling innovations and data quality on these models, encouraging a combined approach for improving fine-grained understanding.
